title: Smart query retry: skip 4xx, retry 5xx/network errors
author: brian-smith-tcril
body_preview: The app query client (`src/queryClient.ts`) sets no `retry` option, so React Query's default applies — **3 retries with exponential backoff for *every* error, including 4xx**. Expected client errors then retry pointlessly: e.g. the courseware outline's expected **403** (denied/logged-out learner) retries 3× (~7s) before it finally settles, and any 4xx slow-fails behind the backoff.
